verdict.rationale: Filee's CLI signals failure explicitly rather than silently. Exit codes separate 'some files failed' (1), 'wrong arguments or a missing input' (2) and 'nothing to convert' (3), and --json prints a per-run result for scripts. However, nothing documents per-file failure reasons such as an unsupported feature or corrupt input, or any guarantee that broken output files are not written. missing for 10: documented per-file failure reasons (unsupported feature vs corrupt input), guarantee of no partial/broken output on failure, GUI error reporting details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a failed conversion reports why it failed (unsupported feature, corrupt input) instead of silently emitting a broken file

citations.quote: "--json" prints the result for scripts; exit codes are 0 (nothing failed), 1 (some files failed), 2 (wrong arguments or a missing input) and 3 (nothing to convert).
